english.title: Contravene drug licence condition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened a

(A)_[condition,]_
(B)_[term,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY TERM/CONDITION..), of

(C)_[a licence issued under section 3 of]_
(D)_[a licence issued under or by virtue of regulations made under]_
(E)_[an authority issued under or by virtue of regulations made under]_

the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 18(2) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened condition / other term
of a licence issued under section 3 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(I) This offence does not apply to the breach of a licence issued under regulations made in pursuance of section 10(2)(i).
(ii) In section 18 (and in references in Schedule 4 that refer to this section), any reference to regulations made under this Act is to be taken as including a reference to provision made in a temporary class drug order by virtue of section 7A, see regulation 18(5) and (6).

other.penalty:
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.
